entries.note: The term 'Relation' appears in the 'Key terms' section, stated as 'Relation.'

entries.claim: A relation from X to Y, where X, Y are two non-empty sets, connects some or all of the elements of X with some or all of the elements of Y.
entries.quote: The relation from X to Y where X, Y are two non-empty sets

entries.claim: X × Y is the set of ordered pairs where the first projection in each ordered pair belongs to X and the second projection belongs to Y.
entries.quote: X × Y is the set of ordered pairs where the first projection

entries.claim: If R is a relation from X to Y, then R is a subset of X × Y.
entries.quote: If R is a relation from X to Y , then R ⊂ X × Y

entries.claim: If R is a relation from a set X to X (itself), then R is called a relation on X, and R ⊂ X × X.
entries.quote: If R is a relation from a set X to X (itself) then R is called a relation
